summary.text: You must update once more because CPF added this step to strengthen protection against scams.

details.heading: Extra security step
details.body: CPF requires this one-time update even if you used PayNow before. It is an added safeguard against scams.

details.heading: What happens after updating
details.body: Your PayNow NRIC-linked bank account will receive your CPF withdrawals and monthly payouts after it is activated with CPF Board.

example_phrasings: Why do I need to update my bank account again?
Why is another PayNow update needed?
Why must I update it if I used PayNow before?

sources.page_title: Why do I need to update my registered bank account with CPF Board to my PayNow NRIC-linked bank account to make PayNow withdrawals if I have already withdrawn via PayNow previously?

quotes.text: This update is required even if you have withdrawn via PayNow previously, as a one-time exercise to strengthen security against scams.
Once your PayNow NRIC-linked bank account has been activated with CPF Board, it will be used to receive your CPF withdrawals and monthly payouts.
